summary.en: A molecule's full Schrödinger equation couples every electron's motion to every nucleus's motion, which is intractable directly — the Born-Oppenheimer approximation exploits the huge mass difference between nuclei and electrons to solve them separately: electrons adjust to the nuclei's positions essentially instantly, giving a potential energy surface on which the much heavier, slower nuclei then vibrate and rotate, each motion quantized into its own ladder of discrete energy levels.
summary.et: Molekuli täielik Schrödingeri võrrand seob kokku igas elektroni ja igas tuuma liikumise, mis on otse lahendamatu — Born-Oppenheimeri lähendus kasutab tuumade ja elektronide vahelist suurt massivahet, et need eraldi lahendada: elektronid kohanevad tuumade asenditega sisuliselt kohe, andes potentsiaalse energia pinna, millel palju raskemad ja aeglasemad tuumad seejärel võnguvad ja pöörlevad, kusjuures kumbki liikumine on kvantiseeritud oma diskreetsete energiatasemete jadaks.
